== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Target The Main Generator (Japanese)|Target The Main Generator]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/148375097/JjhoNjuE6UqXj_VidMX6vw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 148375097.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d671cf26f2ab76bd4202d940dff9ac87d7d0ec829fca27b544e04d1219d9df7f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
